events.text:
In this section, you will take advantage of your robot's thrusters to "dash" or "boost" in order to go faster temporally.
In order to "dash" or "boost" to increase your speed temporally 
Press the shift key if you are using a keyboard and mouse  (the default key for the action. This can be changed in the options menu)
You can "dash" or "boost" in the air and on the ground.
All you have to do is cross the gap and get to the end of the hallway.
Goodluck!
